blocks.text: The TNS-60kVA Three Phase Voltage Stabilizer is a heavy-duty servo motor controlled voltage regulation system designed for large industrial and commercial applications. It provides accurate voltage stabilization, ensuring reliable performance, equipment protection, and long operational life in environments with unstable power supply.
To ensure proper sizing and optimal performance, follow these recommendations:
For purely resistive loads such as heating elements and incandescent lighting, select a stabilizer rated at 1.5 to 2 times the total connected load.
For motors, pumps, air conditioners, compressors, and other inductive loads, select a stabilizer rated at at least 3 times the total load power.
For applications with high starting current (up to 5–8 times rated current), choose a stabilizer with capacity greater than 3 times the load power.

CH392 is an Ethernet protocol stack management chip, which is used for Ethernet communication in MCU system. CH392 has 10M Ethernet Media Access Control (MAC) and Physical Layer (PHY), is fully compatible with IEEE802.3 protocol, and has built-in Ethernet stack firmware such as IP, DHCP, ARP, ICMP, IGMP, UDP and TCP. MCU system can perform network communication conveniently through CH392. CH392 supports two communication interfaces: SPI interface or asynchronous serial port. Controllers such as DSP/MCU/MPU can control CH392 for Ethernet communication through any of the above communication interfaces.
● Internal Ethernet MAC layer and PHY layer.
● Support 10M, full/half duplex self-adaption, and be compatible with 802.3 protocol.
● Built-in TCP/IP protocol stack, and support IPv4, DHCP, ARP, ICMP, IGMP, UDP and TCP protocols.
● Provide 4 independent Socket pairs, simultaneously transmit and receive data.
● Provide SPI device interface with the maximum speed of 8MHz, and support SPI serial bus connected to MCU.
● Provide UART with the maximum speed of 921,600bps, support UART connected to MCU, and support the dynamic adjustment of communication baud rate.
● Built-in 4KB RAM can be used for Ethernet data transmission and receiving, and each Socket transceiver buffer can be freely configured.

The LMx31 family of voltage-to-frequency converters are ideally suited for use in simple low-cost circuits for analog-to-digital conversion, precision frequency-to-voltage conversion, long-term integration, linear frequency modulation or demodulation, and many other functions. The output when used as a voltage-to-frequency converter is a pulse train at a frequency precisely proportional to the applied input voltage. Thus, it provides all the inherent advantages of the voltage-to-frequency conversion techniques, and is easy to apply in all standard voltage-to-frequency converter applications.

The LMx31 uses a new temperature-compensated band-gap reference circuit, to provide excellent accuracy over the full operating temperature range, at power supplies as low as 4 V. The precision timer circuit has low bias currents without degrading the quick response necessary for 100-kHz voltage-to-frequency conversion. And the output are capable of driving 3 TTL loads, or a high-voltage output up to 40 V, yet is short-circuit-proof against VCC.

A load bank is a piece of electrical test equipment used to simulate an electrical load, to test an electric power source without connecting it to its normal operating load. During testing, adjustment, calibration, or verification procedures, a load bank is connected to the output of a power source, such as an electric generator, battery, servoamplifier or photovoltaic system, in place of its usual load. The load bank presents the source with electrical characteristics similar to its standard operating load, while dissipating the power output that would normally be consumed by it. The power is usually converted to heat by a heavy duty resistor or bank of resistive heating elements in the device, and the heat removed by a forced air or water cooling system. The device usually also includes instruments for metering, load control, and overload protection. Load banks can either be permanently installed at a facility to be connected to a power source when needed, or portable versions can be used for testing power sources such as standby generators and batteries. They are necessary adjuncts to replicate, prove, and verify the real-life demands on critical power systems. They are also used during operation of intermittent renewable power sources such as windmills to shed excess power that the electric power grid cannot absorb.

The Mini PWM DC Motor Speed Controller 3-35V 5A 90W is a compact pulse-width modulation (PWM) controller designed to efficiently adjust the speed of brushed DC motors while minimizing power loss. By varying the PWM duty cycle instead of directly reducing the supply voltage, the controller provides smooth motor speed adjustment while maintaining efficient operation.

The module features a built-in resettable (self-recovery) fuse that helps protect the circuit against overcurrent and overload conditions. Its compact size and simple operation make it suitable for hobby, robotics, automation, and DIY electronics projects. An onboard rotary potentiometer provides convenient speed adjustment, while screw terminals allow easy connection to the DC power supply and motor.

شاحن بطاريات ليثيوم ذكي خانة واحدة جي ٨٦ يو ١ بكابل مدمج هو شاحن صغير وعملي مخصص لشحن بطاريات الليثيوم الأسطوانية القابلة للشحن ذات الجهد الاسمي ٣٫٧ فولت. مناسب للمستخدم الذي يحتاج شاحن بسيط وخفيف وسهل الحمل لبطاريات الليثيوم الشائعة المستخدمة في الكشافات، كشافات الرأس، الأجهزة المحمولة، مشروعات الإلكترونيات، أدوات الطاقة الصغيرة، وتجهيزات الطوارئ.

يمتاز هذا الشاحن بوجود كابل شحن مدمج داخل جسمه، لذلك لا يحتاج المستخدم إلى حمل كابل منفصل معه. يمكن توصيل الكابل مباشرة بأي مصدر طاقة مناسب بجهد ٥ فولت مثل شاحن موبايل أو حاسوب أو باور بنك أو شاحن سيارة أو مقبس شحن. هذا يجعله مناسبًا للسفر والاستخدام الميداني وورش الصيانة وحقائب الطوارئ.

يدعم الشاحن مجموعة واسعة من مقاسات بطاريات الليثيوم الأسطوانية ٣٫٧ فولت، ومنها ١٤٥٠٠ و١٤٦٥٠ و١٦٣٤٠ و١٦٦٥٠ و١٨٣٥٠ و١٨٤٩٠ و١٨٥٠٠ و١٨٦٥٠، بالإضافة إلى البطاريات الأكبر مثل ٢٦٦٥٠. يوفر الشاحن خرج شحن ٤٫٢ فولت وتيار شحن ١٠٠٠ مللي أمبير، مع مؤشر ضوئي ذكي يوضح حالة الشحن؛ اللون الأحمر أثناء الشحن، واللون الأخضر عند اكتمال الشحن أو وضع الاستعداد حسب حالة البطارية.

The ATMEGA328P- U is a low-power CMOS 8-bit microcontroller based on the AVR enhanced RISC architecture. By executing powerful instructions in a single clock cycle, the ATmega328P-PU achieves throughputs approaching 1 MIPS per MHz allowing the system designer to optimize power consumption versus processing speed.

The AVR core combines a rich instruction set with 32 general purpose working registers. All the 32 registers are directly connected to the Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU), allowing two independent registers to be accessed in one single instruction executed in one clock cycle. The resulting architecture is more code efficient while achieving throughputs up to ten times faster than conventional CISC microcontrollers.

The ATmega328P-PU AVR is supported with a full suite of program and system development tools including C Compilers, Macro Assemblers, Program Debugger/Simulators, In-Circuit Emulators, and Evaluation Kits.

blocks.text: ESP8266 D1 R1 WiFi Processor with Uno Footprint

The ESP8266 D1 R1 WiFi board utilizes the ESP8266 WiFi enabled processor, and puts it onto an Arduino Uno board footprint. It provides a way to work with the ESP8266 in a familiar setup and does not require a breadboard in order to make interconnections since it has the typical on-board female headers. It will also work with some Uno shields that have compatible I/O pin-outs.
KEY FEATURES OF ESP8266 D1 R1

Besides adding WiFi capability, the main claim to fame for the ESP8266 processor over the AVR processor of the standard Arduino is that it has a larger 4MB of Flash memory and runs at clock speeds of 80MHz and can sometimes optionally be overclocked to 160MHz and has a very fast processing speed.

The Digital I/O except for D0 all support PWM and interrupts. In addition they can be configured to have pull-up or pull-down resistors On the down-side, it has only 1 analog input which is probably the most significant limitation. That can always be overcome by using an external Analog Mux module like our 16-channel 74HC4067, ADS1115 4-Channel 16-bit ADC or the MCP3008-I/P 8 channel A/D converter IC below if more analog I/O is desired.

Per spec, the digital I/O is limited to 3.3V, but the ESP-8266 mfr has made statements that the digital pins are in fact 5V tolerant and there are many installations using the module directly connected to the logic lines of 5V peripherals.

Note that when programming the board, you need to refer to the I/O using both the letter and number. With Arduino, output D3 would be referred to simply as ‘3’, but with the D1 board, you need to refer to the pin as ‘D3’.
The board can be powered via the USB port or using an external 7-12V power supply via the DC Power Jack. The board runs at 3.3V, so keep that in mind when working with I/O.

makers-10497.summary: The TIP147 is a PNP power Darlington transistor in a TO-247 package. It offers a high current gain of 500, handles 10A and 100V.

blocks.text: Tip147 PNP Darlington Bipolar Power Transistor (10A, 100V) TO-247

The TIP147 is a PNP complementary power Darlington transistor manufactured using planar technology with a specific “base island” layout. Its core is a monolithic Darlington configuration, which means two transistors are integrated onto a single silicon chip. This arrangement connects the emitters and collectors in a way that the current amplified by the first transistor is further amplified by the second, resulting in a single device with a very high overall current gain. This monolithic construction ensures stability and performance consistency.

This transistor is engineered to deliver exceptional high-gain performance while maintaining a very low saturation voltage. The low saturation voltage is critical as it minimizes power loss when the transistor is fully switched on, making it efficient for power control applications. The device is also characterized by its robust voltage and current handling capabilities, designed to operate reliably in demanding industrial environments where linear control and power switching are required.

A key feature of the TIP147’s design is the integration of an antiparallel collector-emitter diode. This built-in diode provides a path for reverse current, which is essential for managing inductive kickback when driving loads like motors or solenoids, thereby protecting the transistor from voltage spikes. Housed in a TO-247 package, the device is built for high power dissipation and is easily mounted onto a heat sink to manage thermal performance under high load conditions.

blocks.text: Handheld 125KHz RFID Copier Reader Writer with 5 Cards and 5 Tags

Handheld 125KHz RFID Copier is a compact, stand-alone tool for reading the identification code from compatible unencrypted low-frequency cards and writing that code to a supported writable card or key tag. The package includes 5 cards and 5 key tags, giving technicians and authorized users a practical starter set for backups, access-control maintenance, compatibility testing, and RFID learning.

Important compatibility notice: This device is not a universal card copier. It is intended only for compatible unencrypted 125KHz ID credentials. It does not copy 13.56MHz, NFC, MIFARE, encrypted, protected, rolling-code, banking, national-ID, SIM, or secure smart cards. Confirm the frequency, chip type, and writability of the original credential before purchasing.

The copier works without a computer, application, cable, or external programmer. A dedicated READ button captures the code from a compatible original credential, while the WRITE button transfers it to compatible writable media. The front panel includes Power, Pass, and Busy indicators, and the antenna area is positioned at the upper section of the housing. A side power switch and audible feedback support simple field operation.

The lightweight ABS enclosure has a contoured handheld shape for workshops, service visits, access-control testing, and educational demonstrations. Power is supplied by two AAA batteries, allowing the unit to operate away from a bench supply. Batteries are not included.

Epobond GP‑5000 is a professional‑grade cyanoacrylate (CA) instant adhesive designed for fast, reliable bonding on a wide range of materials. Compared with light‑thin general CA, GP‑5000 features a medium viscosity body that stays where you place it, making it perfect for vertical surfaces, slightly uneven fits, and gap‑tolerant joints. blocks.text: Raspberry Pi 5 Clear Plastic Case with Cooling Fan – Board Not Included

The transparent body gives the case a clean and functional look while allowing the internal board layout to remain visible during installation, testing, and regular use. This makes it useful for education, prototyping, bench testing, and embedded system projects where visibility of the board is helpful.

This enclosure includes a cooling fan mounted in the top section, helping move air over the board area to reduce heat buildup during operation. It is especially useful in projects where Raspberry Pi 5 is used for longer operating periods, continuous processing, media applications, automation systems, or compact electronics builds where extra airflow is beneficial.

The case is shaped to provide access to the common Raspberry Pi 5 interfaces, including USB ports, Ethernet, GPIO header area, and card access. Its two-part plastic structure helps keep the board protected from accidental contact while maintaining a compact and lightweight form.

This product should be understood as a case with fan only. The Raspberry Pi 5 board itself is not included. It is intended for users who already have a Raspberry Pi 5 board and need a neat transparent housing with active cooling support.

blocks.text: The BZX79-C4V7 4.7V Voltage Regulator Zener Diode is a low-power semiconductor component designed to maintain an approximately stable voltage when operated in its reverse-breakdown region.

It provides a nominal Zener voltage of 4.7V at the specified test current. Therefore, it is suitable for voltage-reference circuits, basic voltage stabilization, signal clipping, level limiting, and low-power protection applications.

The diode is supplied in a compact hermetically sealed axial glass package. Its through-hole leads make it suitable for breadboards, prototype boards, educational circuits, maintenance work, and conventional printed circuit boards.
Package: SOD27, commonly identified as DO-35
Easy to use in prototypes and PCB circuits

The BZX79-C4V7 4.7V Voltage Regulator Zener Diode can provide a basic voltage reference for transistor, sensor, and analog circuits. Additionally, it can be used for signal clipping and limiting when the circuit requires a voltage near 4.7V.

It is also useful in low-current shunt-regulator circuits and input-protection networks. However, the diode is not a replacement for a high-current voltage regulator, TVS diode, or complete power-supply protection circuit.
A Zener diode is normally connected in reverse bias for voltage regulation. The cathode is identified by the band printed around one side of the glass body.

For a typical regulator circuit, connect the cathode toward the positive supply and the anode toward ground. Moreover, a correctly calculated series resistor must be connected to limit the current through the diode.
When used in forward bias, the component behaves similarly to a standard silicon diode. However, its main intended function is reverse-breakdown voltage regulation.
The 4.7V value is nominal and is measured under specified test conditions. The actual voltage can vary with current, component tolerance, temperature, and circuit design.
Always calculate the series resistor according to the input voltage, load current, required Zener current, and power dissipation. Furthermore, do not exceed the maximum 500mW power rating.
This product is supplied as one individual diode unless another quantity is selected.

OLED (Organic Light-Emitting Diode) is a self-light-emitting technology composed of a thin, multi-layered organic film placed between an anode and cathode. In contrast to LCD technology, OLED does not require a backlight. OLED possesses high application potential for virtually all types of displays and is regarded as the ultimate technology for the next generation of flat-panel displays.

OLEDs basic structure consists of organic materials positioned between the cathode and the anode, which is composed of electric conductive transparent Indium Tin Oxide (ITO). The organic materials compose a multi-layered thin film, which includes the Hole Transporting Layer (HTL), Emission Layer (EML) and the Electron Transporting Layer (ETL). By applying the appropriate electric voltage, holes and electrons are injected into the EML from the anode and the cathode, respectively. The holes and electrons combine inside the EML to form excitons, after which electroluminescence occurs. The transfer material, emission layer material, and choice of electrode are the key factors that determine the quality of OLED components.

The Arduino UNO R4 WiFi Development Board is the latest evolution of the classic Arduino Uno, pairing a 32-bit Renesas RA4M1 processor with an onboard ESP32-S3 module for built-in WiFi and Bluetooth. It keeps the familiar Uno pinout while adding a 12×8 LED matrix, USB-C port, and DAC for more capable projects.
Microcontroller: Renesas RA4M1 (Arm Cortex-M4) with an onboard ESP32-S3 co-processor for wireless connectivity.
Wireless Connectivity: Built-in 2.4GHz WiFi and Bluetooth 5.0 via the onboard ESP32-S3 module.
USB-C Programming Port: Modern USB-C connector for programming and power, replacing the older USB-B.
Built-in LED Matrix: A 12×8 addressable LED matrix for simple visual feedback without extra wiring.
Classic Uno Pinout: Fully compatible with existing Uno shields, with 14 digital I/O pins and 6 analog inputs.
Onboard DAC: A 12-bit digital-to-analog converter for smoother analog signal generation.
